entities.name: Nightstalkers
entities.description: A species of malevolent black-mana humanoids with elongated limbs, spiked hair and sharp teeth.

entities.name: Tojira
entities.description: Swamp queen of Dakmor who magically created nightstalker servants.

entities.name: Kaervek
entities.description: Whose nightstalker minions served as assassins in his attempt to conquer Jamuraa.

entities.name: Spirit of the Night
entities.description: Mysterious entity the Urborg nightstalkers worshipped.

entities.name: Palladia-Mors
entities.description: Summoned a Shimian Night Stalker using a Black Mana Battery.

entities.name: Dakmor
entities.description: Place where nightstalkers were most prolific.

events.summary: Tojira magically creates nightstalker servants in Dakmor and arms them.
events.quote: they were magically created servants of the swamp queen Tojira

events.summary: Kaervek's nightstalker assassins serve in his bid to conquer Jamuraa; the Breathstealers kill Qhattib.
events.quote: infamously killing the Suq'Atan vizier Qhattib of Amiqat
